function.name: subagent_spawn
function.description: Delegate a goal to a new subagent with a required lifetime timeout. Foreground mode waits for its result in this tool call; background mode returns immediately and reports the result to its parent when it finishes.

kind.description: Which kind of agent to spawn (the role best suited to the goal, e.g. "worker"). Call subagent_list_spawnable to see the kinds you may spawn.

name.description: Required short name for this subagent, shown by subagent_list/subagent_watch so you can tell several subagents of the same kind apart. It is a label only — subagent_delete and everything else still use the returned agent id.

goal.description: The goal to delegate to the subagent.

foreground.description: Required execution mode. true waits for the subagent and returns its result from this tool call. false returns the agent id immediately; the result is delivered asynchronously to the spawning parent.

timeout_ms.description: Required maximum lifetime of this subagent and all work it owns, in milliseconds. On expiry the runtime reports a failed result and atomically deletes this agent's entire subtree.
